query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN parentId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as main_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN parentId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sub_count
FROM product_categories;
